description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectController class within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages project-related UI components and permissions, specifically preparing a project list component with unselectable project IDs and setting appropriate permissions.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing project-related views and permissions in the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It prepares a Vue component with unselectable project IDs for rendering in the user interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the project list component before rendering, by fetching unselectable project IDs and setting component properties and permissions.
